- .github/workflows/ci.yml:about line 3534 (tests-system-python, "System-Python test shard" step, `export TMPDIR="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}"`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The TMPDIR export applies to the whole pytest process, so tmp_path lands under /home/runner/work/_temp/pytest-of-runner/pytest-0/<test>/. The heal tests set RUNNER_TEMP=str(tmp_path) (tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py lines 166, 229, 742, 913, 1344), and scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:35 mktemp plus line 96 bind `${root}/socket/provider.sock` give a 125-byte path, over the 108-byte AF_UNIX limit (106 bytes with the default /tmp base).
  WHY: Run 43053071771 shard 3 fails with "OSError: AF_UNIX path too long ... reason=broker_exited", with the same clusters in shards 0, 4, 5 and 10. tests-system-python is in lint.needs. Suggested fix: drop the TMPDIR export or pass a short `--basetemp`.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:about lines 3441-3445 (`timeout-minutes: 20`, `system-python-shard: [0..11]`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Each shard gets about 970 tests; shard 3 spent 809 s in pytest plus about 26 s of collection, and shards 0, 4 and 10 were killed at 87%, 88% and 95% (timeouts, not sibling cancellation, because fail-fast is false).
  WHY: lint reports "tests-system-python: cancelled". Suggested fix: lengthen the matrix list (for example 0..23).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml + tests/test_sandbox_python_coverage.py (tests-sandbox-python job: `fetch-depth: 1`, no CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA, no live-copy prep; `_GUARD_TESTS = ["tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py"]`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: A template-only PR passes the 3.12 jobs and tests-system-python but fails all three sandbox legs. Suggested fix: `--deselect tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py::test_template_parity`.
- changelog.d/9233-ci-runtime-python.md:line 11 (second `<!-- changelog: fixed -->`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  WHY: The slop_scan_local.py fix lands under "### Added" and Fixed never gets the entry. Suggested fix: put it in its own fragment (for example changelog.d/9233-slop-scan-ast-str.md).
